Application Data.NAME: Paws & Claws Pet Emporium
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Paws & Claws Pet Emporium is a reputable pet store and grooming service specializing in the care and grooming of common domestic animals such as dogs and cats. We offer a clean, safe environment equipped with secure animal enclosures, non-slip flooring, and proper ventilation. Our staff are trained in animal handling, grooming techniques, and safety protocols, with certifications in pet first aid and grooming safety. We use only grooming products approved by recognized veterinary and regulatory bodies to ensure the well-being of the animals in our care. Our operations include both in-store grooming services and limited online sales, for which we maintain necessary cyber liability coverage to protect customer data. We are committed to sourcing live animals exclusively from licensed and reputable breeders who comply with animal welfare regulations. Our goal is to provide excellent service while ensuring the highest standards of safety and compliance in all our business operations.
